entries.d9347ab3f559cdc6: The company's corporate group consists of the company, its parent Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd., and one affiliate, ODN Solution Co., Ltd., and it conducts business centered on the information services industry. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and segment information is omitted because it has a single segment. Its head office is located in Shinkawa, Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and as of June 30, 2026, it had 534 employees. Its business is mainly divided into two fields, business for the financial industry and information security measures business, and under its medium-term management plan it has been reorganized into and operates three business domains: “Payments,” “Security,” and “Data Communication and Analytics Platform.”
